stories.title: Pure helper: seconds to frames
stories.description: As a tool author, I want a tested seconds-to-frames helper so that every tool converts time the same way.
steps: Read docs/hackathon/06-contracts.md section 3a (time is in frames, fps = 30) and shared/composition.ts.
Create server/authoring/units.ts exporting secToFrames(sec: number, fps = 30): number (rounds to the nearest frame, throws RangeError if sec < 0) and framesToSec(frames, fps).
Create server/authoring/units.test.ts covering 0, 0.5, 2.0, a rounding case (0.016 s -> 0) and the negative-input error.
acceptance: secToFrames(-1) throws RangeError with a message that names the value
framesToSec(secToFrames(x)) is within one frame of x for 100 random inputs in [0, 30] s

stories.title: Example panel shows the status line
stories.description: As a viewer, I want to see the film status so that I know what the director is doing.
steps: Read web/src/api/sse.ts (the useFilmEvents hook) and the FilmEvent union in shared/events.ts.
Create web/src/panels/Example.tsx rendering the latest film.status event as a labelled badge.
Add web/src/panels/Example.test.tsx using @testing-library/react with a fake event list.
acceptance: With a 'building' status event the badge text is 'Building'
With no events the badge text is 'Waiting'
